text: BAM share rose 0.31 percentage points over 24 hours, and 1.51 percentage points over 7 days, to 34.2% of all Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 22.3% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Top-node leadership has changed hands 63 times in this window, consistent with whale-driven routing rather than a structural rollover.
